title: Graph Dirichlet Energy for Fitting-Free Bivariate Causal Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.21892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose the Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion for distinguishing cause from effect in bivariate settings. For a candidate direction $X\to Y$, we construct a kernel similarity graph from $X$ and treat $Y$ as a graph signal. The score is the Dirichlet energy of this signal, induced by the unnormalized graph Laplacian. The reverse score swaps the variables, and the lower-energy direction is inferred as causal. The method requires neither regression fitting nor independence testing. After the empirical probability integral transform, its decisions are invariant under strictly monotone transformations of either variable, and the graph operations reduce to convolutions, allowing exact evaluation in $O(n\log n)$ time and $O(n)$ memory. translated_title: 用于免拟合二元因果推断的图狄利克雷能量
translated_abstract: 我们提出了图狄利克雷能量因果推断（GDECI）准则，用于在二元设置中区分原因与结果。对于候选方向 X→Y，我们基于 X 构建核相似性图，并将 Y 视为图上的信号。得分即为该信号的狄利克雷能量，由未归一化的图拉普拉斯算子诱导。反向得分则交换两个变量的角色，能量较低的方向被推断为因果方向。该方法既不需要回归拟合，也不需要独立性检验。经过经验概率积分变换后，其判别结果在任一变量的严格单调变换下保持不变，且图运算可简化为卷积，从而可在 O(n log n) 时间和 O(n) 内存内实现精确计算。在总体层面，GDECI 比较的是度加权贝叶斯平方预测误差加上回归函数的一个非负平滑项。当带宽趋于零时……
tldr: 本文提出免拟合的图狄利克雷能量因果推断准则（GDECI），通过比较两个方向上图信号的狄利克雷能量来判别二元因果方向，无需回归拟合或独立性检验，具有单调变换不变性，并可高效地在 O(n log n) 时间内精确计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the fitting-free Graph Dirichlet Energy Causal Inference (GDECI) criterion, which identifies the causal direction in bivariate settings by comparing Dirichlet energies of graph signals, requiring neither regression fitting nor independence testing, while being invariant to strictly monotone transformations and exactly computable in O(n log n) time.
